parameters.note: Rest between work sets, low volume and high intensity (Güray K-49: 2-3 minutes; the aim is mechanical tension, not metabolic stress). The session's rest timer counts up and shows the band (K-405); the timer in the background and the Live Activity are K-411.

The quick RIR picker (B 6.5: one tap per set): 0, 1, 2 and 3+. The last choice means 3 or more and is logged as 3; work sets aim at 0-1 (target_rir_max, G1 K-5), so anything past 3 says the same thing: further from failure than planned.
NewSet.loadKg maximum: a heavier set would be refused by the server and lost from the queue.
NewSet.reps maximum. A set logged here has at least one rep: zero is not a set done.

The same as training.yaml (the engine's, K-218): the session summary (K-406) shows the estimated max of a set the way the engine reads it. Epley: load x (1 + reps to failure / 30), reps to failure = reps + RIR. MobileParameterMirrorTests keeps the two equal.
The same as training.yaml: no estimate past 10 reps to failure (Mayhew 2008).

The same as training.yaml: work sets end at RIR 0-1. The summary judges the effort against the planned RIR, and against this when the plan has none (a day gone from the program). MobileParameterMirrorTests keeps it equal.
